en: Vintage black-and-white panoramic view over central Budapest, taken from the slopes of Gellért Hill looking toward the Danube River. A busy city square and streets with horse-drawn carriages and early trams are visible in the foreground, along with ornate historic buildings. In the background, the Chain Bridge spans the Danube and the dome of the Hungarian Parliament Building appears on the right. At the far left on the hilltop stands the large palace-like complex of the Royal Palace/Buda Castle. Red printed text in Hungarian and German is at the top of the postcard.
